text: 告诉你一个秘密：人到中年，不要在朋友圈炫耀这三样东西。
en: Let me tell you a secret: once you reach middle age, do not show off these three things on your WeChat Moments.

text: 古语云：“木秀于林，风必摧之；堆出于岸，流必湍之。
en: As the old saying goes: “A tree that towers above the forest will surely be broken by the wind; an earth mound that rises beyond the bank will surely be swept away by the current.

text: 那些高出森林的大树，总要先被大风吹倒；那些超出河岸的土堆，必先被水流冲走。
en: Those tall trees that rise above the forest are always the first to be blown down by the gale; those earth mounds that exceed the riverbank are always the first to be carried off by the current.

text: 为人处世亦如此，忌锋芒毕露，若到处炫耀自己，非但赚不到虚荣，还会招致灾祸。
en: Conducting oneself in the world is much the same; one must avoid flaunting one's talents, for if you show off everywhere, you will not only fail to win any hollow glory, but will also bring disaster upon yourself.

text: 人到中年，不要在朋友圈炫耀这三样东西。
en: Once you reach middle age, do not show off these three things on your WeChat Moments.

text: 爱炫富的人层次很低，腰有十文钱，必振衣作响，掉进钱眼，活得无趣。
en: Those who love to flaunt their wealth are of very low character; with ten coins at their waist they must rustle their clothes so they jingle, fall headlong into the love of money, and live a joyless life.

text: 凡是跟人聊天，必谈自家的车、房，惟恐别人不知道自己有钱。
en: Whenever they chat with others, they must speak of their own car and house, for fear that others might not know they are rich.

text: 如今，很多人喜欢用各种方式在朋友圈炫耀自己的财力，本质无二。
en: Nowadays, many people like to flaunt their wealth on WeChat Moments in all sorts of ways, and the essence is no different.

text: 老子说：“金玉满堂，莫之能守；富贵而骄，自遗其咎。
en: Laozi said: “Gold and jade may fill the hall, yet none can keep them; wealth and honour with arrogance bring ruin upon oneself.

text: 奢侈和炫富，容易招人眼红，给自己惹来灾祸，出问题是早晚的事情。
en: Extravagance and the flaunting of wealth easily stir envy in others and bring disaster upon oneself; it is only a matter of time before trouble comes.

text: 不炫富，不奢侈，我们才能稳稳地守住自己的人生和钱包。
en: Only by not flaunting our wealth and not being extravagant can we steadily guard our own lives and our wallets.

text: 生活中有这样一类人，总是将“人脉”二字挂在嘴边，最喜欢炫耀的是自己有多少微信好友。
en: In life there is a kind of person who always has the term “connections” on their lips, and what they most like to show off is how many WeChat friends they have.

text: 这类人发朋友圈，要么是参加了哪个大咖的酒会；要么是和某某某的合影；又或是和哪位大老板有过一次高谈阔论。
en: This kind of person posts on WeChat Moments — either having attended some big shot's drinks party, or a photograph with so-and-so, or having once held forth in grand conversation with some tycoon.

text: 人脉不是认识了谁，而是在你需要的时候，谁能出现在你身边。
en: Connections are not about who you know, but about who can be by your side when you need them.

text: 其实那不过是逢场作戏的关系，没有实力的人脉，都是空中楼阁，风一吹就散。
en: In truth that is nothing but a relationship of going through the motions; connections without real strength are all castles in the air, scattered by a mere gust of wind.

text: 与其把希望寄托于别人，不如寄托于自己。
en: Rather than place your hopes in others, it is better to place them in yourself.

text: 生活中，却总有那么一种人，他们很少应酬，参加饭局酒会，却总被人提起，他们的优秀就是最好的人脉。
en: Yet in life there is always that kind of person who seldom socialises, who attends dinners and drinks parties, yet is always spoken of by others; their excellence is the very best connection of all.

text: 人到中年，要懂得低调，没有人脉却不断吹嘘自己的人，只会成为别人的笑谈。
en: Upon reaching middle age, one must understand the worth of keeping a low profile; those who have no connections yet never stop boasting about themselves will only become the laughing stock of others.

text: 真正的友情，从来不是喧嚣的，也不需要昭告天下。
en: True friendship is never loud, nor does it need to be proclaimed to the whole world.

text: 常言道：“水深而流缓，人贵而语迟。
en: As the common saying goes: “Deep water flows gently, and a person of worth speaks with restraint.

text: 水有多深，未必能在表面看得出来，深不见底的河水往往波平浪静;能够让人一眼见底的，只能是浅水。
en: How deep the water is cannot necessarily be seen on the surface; water of unfathomable depth often lies still and calm, while only shallow water can be seen through at a glance.

text: 唯有浅薄的人才喜欢卖弄玄虚，逢人便自吹自擂自己的才华与成就。
en: Only shallow people like to put on an air of profundity, boasting of their own talent and achievements to everyone they meet.

text: 为人高调张扬，往往肚子里没有干货。
en: Those who conduct themselves with a high profile and ostentation often have no real substance within.

text: “圣者无名，大者无形”，真正有学识、有涵养的人，是不会得意忘形、到处炫耀的。
en: “The sage has no name, the great has no form,” yet those who are truly learned and cultivated will not lose themselves in complacency and show off everywhere.

text: 才高而不自诩，位高而不自傲。
en: One may be of high talent yet not praise oneself, of high station yet not be arrogant.

text: 博学的人往往谦虚、低调，不显山不露水，默默耕耘，才能更好地将手头的事做好，踏踏实实，无问西东。
en: Learned people are often humble and low-key; without showing off, they till the soil in silence, so as to do the task at hand all the better — steady and grounded, asking nothing of east or west.

text: 成功可以引以为豪，但不必炫耀。
en: Success may be a source of pride, yet there is no need to show it off.

text: 低调，是为了生活在自己的世界里；高调，是为了生活在别人的生活里。
en: A low profile is so that one may live in one's own world; a high profile is so that one may live in the lives of others.

text: 人到中年，要看穿虚荣，不必太在意虚名浮象，而是去追求内心真正想要的生活，活给自己看。
en: Upon reaching middle age, one must see through vanity, need not care too much for empty fame and superficial appearances, but instead pursue the life one truly desires in one's heart, living for oneself.

text: 不去显摆，而是保持低调，静对自我的世界，独享一份平和与从容，淡泊豁达，快意人生。
en: Rather than showing off, keep a low profile; face your own world in quiet, and savour a measure of peace and composure alone — indifferent and open-hearted, living life with ease and joy.

text: 生活是自己的，面子再好，都不如里子重要。
en: Life is your own; however fine the outward face, it is never as important as the substance within.

text: 多一点人间烟火的真实，少一点哗众取宠的人设。
en: Have a little more of the genuine warmth of everyday life, and a little less of the persona that panders to the crowd.

text: 以上，祝各位好运！
en: The above — and I wish you all good luck!

text: 过两天就40岁了，86年生的，有很多的人生感受的话想说。
en: In a couple of days I will be forty; born in 1986, I have many feelings about life that I wish to express.

text: 世界太严肃了，我要知道世界上有的人就是可以什么都不管的过活。
en: The world is too serious; I need to know that there are people in this world who can simply live caring about nothing at all.

text: 为什么我要对人百依百顺，对人点头哈腰，对朋友油嘴滑舌？
en: Why must I be utterly obedient to others, bow and scrape before people, and be glib and smooth-tongued with my friends?

text: 为什么我要千方百计地维系人际关系，沒事问候，有事送礼？
en: Why must I go to great lengths to maintain relationships, offering greetings when there is nothing to say and giving gifts when there is something to do?

text: 不累么？
en: Is that not tiring?

text: 累，但是要生存。
en: Tiring, but one must survive.

text: 有人会说你丫就是一中二病发作，不这样做，你以为你是富二代还是钱会送到你口袋里？
en: Some will say you are simply having a bout of middle-schooler syndrome; if you do not act this way, do you think you are a second-generation rich kid, or that money will be delivered into your pocket?

text: 有人会说我承认，这些只是一些美好的幻想，幼稚的以为世界为我旋转，低智地对世界宣战。
en: Some will say I must admit that these are but beautiful fantasies — a naïve belief that the world revolves around me, a witless declaration of war upon the world.

text: 但我发现原來自己做不到时，就会想找到一些安慰，找到一些人正在用我所期待的方式生活。
en: But I found that when I myself could not manage it, I would want to find some comfort, to find people who are living in the very way I had longed for.

text: 就像我喜欢的英剧布莱克书店，它就是要告訴你，Bernard大爷我就是什么也不管，什么也不做，我就是要嘴贱，抽烟，喝酒，看书，冷嘲热讽，落井下石，喝杀虫水治感冒，也不要向我不喜欢的东西屈服。
en: Just like the British series Black Books that I love — it tells you, Old Bernard, that I simply care about nothing and do nothing; I just want to be foul-mouthed, to smoke, drink, read, sneer and scoff, kick a man when he is down, drink insecticide to cure a cold, and still not yield to the things I dislike.

text: 没错，就是不屈服。
en: Exactly — it is simply refusal to yield.

text: 或者我们会过得很糟，我们会被人嘲笑，我们也许是屁民，可是，沒有什么不好。
en: Perhaps we shall live badly, perhaps we shall be laughed at by others, perhaps we are mere nobodies — yet there is nothing wrong with that.

text: 並非每个人天生就是Sherlock, 或者成功的商人，政客，学者，等等。
en: Not everyone is born to be a Sherlock, or a successful businessman, politician, scholar, and so on.

text: 有的人就不能安于他的小世界吗？
en: Can some people simply not be content in their own little world?

text: 这並非是自暴自弃或者不求进取啊，只是，我过我想过的生活，我做我想做的事情，我听我喜欢的音乐，我爱我想爱的朋友，无非是一种生活方式罢了。
en: This is by no means self-abandonment or a lack of ambition; it is only that I live the life I wish to live, do the things I wish to do, listen to the music I like, and love the friends I wish to love — it is no more than a way of living, that is all.

text: “广告诱惑我们买车子，衣服，于是拼命工作买不需要的东西，然后被历史遗忘，没有目的，没有地位，没有世界大战，没有经济大恐慌，我们的大战只是心灵之战，我们的恐慌只是我们的生活。
en: “Advertising tempts us to buy cars and clothes, so we work desperately to buy things we do not need, and are then forgotten by history; no purpose, no status, no world war, no great economic panic — our great war is only a war of the spirit, our panic is only our own lives.

text: 我们从小看电视，相信有一天会成为富翁，明星或摇滚巨星，但是，我们不会。
en: We grew up watching television, believing that one day we would become wealthy, stars, or rock superstars — but we will not.

text: 那是我们逐渐面对着的现实，所以我们非常愤怒。
en: That is the reality we gradually come to face, and so we are filled with anger.

text: 就像逍遥骑士中的Wyatt和Billy的公路旅行，为什么要上路？
en: Just like in Easy Rider, with Wyatt and Billy's road trip — why did they set out on the road?

text: 因为要逃避，因为要寻找，逃避什么？
en: Because they wanted to escape, because they wanted to search — escape from what?

text: 寻找什么？
en: Search for what?

text: 逃避麻木的生活，逃避看似自由，实则处处受制的现实，逃避虚伪的卫道士们敌意的侧目，寻找生活的真正意义，寻找梦想的自由，寻找平等友好的乌托邦，贴完邮票后的Waytt对Billy说“we blew it”，是的，我们愤怒的抛弃一切然后却搞砸了这一切，最后被卫道士手中的枪杀死。
en: To escape a numb life, to escape a reality that seems free yet is in fact constrained at every turn, to escape the hostile sidelong glances of hypocritical moralists; to search for the true meaning of life, to search for the freedom of dreams, to search for an equal and friendly utopia — after sticking on the stamp, Waytt says to Billy, “we blew it”; yes, we angrily cast aside everything, only to botch it all, and in the end are killed by the gun in the moralists' hands.

text: 脱离轨道的怪人不讨人喜欢，因为世界太快了，他们没有时间去了解一个怪人，所以杀死眼前的怪人是他们最好的选择。
en: Those oddballs who stray from the track are not well liked, because the world moves too fast and people have no time to understand an eccentric; thus killing the oddball before them is their best choice.

text: 我从小长在区委大院，受身边的影响家里有很多书、漫画、任天堂8位机游戏和流行音乐卡带，那个年代父亲总能搞到一些非法出版物然后带回家，用当年时髦的东洋随身听欣赏邓丽君以及各种国内拼盘盒带，书籍上王朔、贾平凹、莫言以及武侠、侦探小说也都没有断过。
en: I grew up in a district-committee compound, and under the influence around me our home had many books, comics, Nintendo 8-bit games, and pop-music cassettes; in those years my father could always get hold of some illegal publications and bring them home, and with the fashionable Japanese Walkman of those days I listened to Lijun Deng and all sorts of domestic compilation tapes, while on the bookshelves the works of Shuo Wang, Pingwa Jia, and Yan Mo, as well as wuxia and detective novels, never ran out.

text: 对我来说旁人缺的东西我还算没缺过，这些东西潜移默化的影响了以后的我，他们自由的教育方式让我相对来说跟同龄的其他小孩不一样，所以我跟小伙伴们在一起的时候想法总是不在一条平行线，时间长了我也不再喜欢跟他们争论交流，有时我自己也能玩的高兴。
en: As for me, the things others lacked I was more or less spared from lacking; these things quietly and imperceptibly shaped the person I later became, and their free way of upbringing made me, compared with other children my age, somewhat different — so when I was with my little companions my thoughts were never on the same parallel line as theirs, and in time I also stopped caring to argue and chat with them; sometimes I could amuse myself happily enough on my own.

text: 再大了一点以后喜欢的东西在别人眼里越来越奇怪，当怪胎的滋味非常不好受，高中三年简直就是灾难，周围的人觉得我是在装文艺，周杰伦流行的时候我根本不听，因为这个有个同学说我已经老了，自己写了一些作文被老师怀疑是不是抄袭，不过这个语文老师给我影响很大，最后写的一篇作文还被她拿出来选进高三那年我们毕业的作文选集，身边的人都对我冷嘲热讽，我总是永远被忽略的那一个，我对这些都毫不介意但又有不甘。
en: A little older, the things I liked seemed ever stranger in others' eyes; the taste of being a freak was truly hard to bear, and my three years of senior high were all but a disaster. Those around me thought I was putting on an artistic pretence; when Jielun Zhou was all the rage I simply would not listen to him, and because of this a classmate said I had already grown old; some essays I wrote myself were suspected by the teacher of being plagiarised — yet this Chinese teacher influenced me greatly, and the final essay I wrote was even taken out by her and selected into the graduation anthology of essays in our senior year. Everyone around me mocked and sneered at me, and I was always the one forever overlooked; I did not care in the least about all this, yet still felt a measure of unwillingness.

text: 大学荒废的青春让我知道在这个文化的废墟上已没人觉得你狂野，那个大声朗读朦胧诗的年代，那个崔健横空出世的80年代末和90年代前期是我的乌托邦。
en: The wastrel youth of my university years taught me that upon the ruins of this culture no one thinks you wild any more; that age when people read Misty Poetry aloud, that time at the end of the 1980s and the early 1990s when Jian Cui burst upon the scene, was my utopia.

text: 对于喜好来说所有的东西我只是喜欢一点点而已，听的音乐看的电影没有那些乐评和影评人多，看过的名著估计也还没有普通人多，我只是不断的尝试新鲜事物，而这其实真的只有一点点的喜好旁人看来却是我向往的一切。
en: As for my tastes, I only like everything a little; the music I listen to and the films I watch are fewer than those of the music and film critics, and the famous books I have read are probably still fewer than an ordinary person's; I merely keep trying new things, and this slight fondness of mine is seen by others as everything I aspire to.

text: 有姑娘问我我的初心是什么，我告诉她那就是永远像一个孩子般聆听，时刻保持创造性和想象力。
en: A girl asked me what my original intention was, and I told her it was to listen forever like a child, keeping creativity and imagination alive at all times.

text: 她觉得我是一个没有琐碎生活的人，觉得我生活在云端，没有踏踏实实的走在地上。
en: She felt I was someone without the trivialities of daily life, that I lived among the clouds, not walking steadfastly upon the ground.

text: 她说的都对，但我不能同意，对于我的生活她也只能冷眼旁观，所以我们相遇的时候，碰巧是我人生中最诡异的一段时间。
en: What she said was all correct, but I cannot agree; as for my life, she could only look on coldly, so when we met it happened to be the strangest stretch of time in my life.

text: 因为不被太阳普照，所以深埋在我肌肤里的蓝色骨头总是在夜里发光；而这蓝色的光足够照亮我前进的方向。
en: Because I am not shone upon by the sun, the blue bone buried deep in my skin always glows at night; and this blue light is enough to illuminate the direction of my advance.

text: 生命只有一次机会，我只想按照自己的方式猛力的活，以至于我能达到这颗行星所有酒馆的尽头。
en: Life gives but one chance; I only wish to live fiercely in my own way, so that I may reach the end of all the taverns upon this planet.

text: 若太阳，拒绝普照，我不介意！
en: If the sun refuses to shine on all, I do not mind!

text: 若高山，沉入大海，让它去吧！
en: If the high mountains sink into the sea, let them be!

text: 与我无关！
en: Nothing to do with me!

text: 永逝降临，我不悲伤。
en: Eternal passing comes; I do not grieve.
